issues.on_page: Other local receipts 220,836 (General Fund column 200,929 = General Fund local items 60,929 + Depreciation Fund 'Transfer in From General' 140,000, p9/p5)
issues.issue: [fixed] 140,000 of this receipt line is a transfer ('Transfer in From General', p9), so it is counted as revenue. The rules say transfers are never revenue, even one-sided ones (record as the rules say and add decision_needed). The page prints the breakdown: the p4 General Fund column = General 10,436,965 + Depreciation 140,403 + Employee Benefit 21 = 10,577,389, and p9 itemizes the 140,000. So it should be split out (split_from) as transfers_in 140,000 (transfers_in 441,656 vs transfers_out 301,656, one-sided), leaving 80,836 in receipts and reported_totals as printed. decision_needed already raises the question, but the line is still recorded as revenue.

Apart from the 140,000 transfer, the 80,836 left is identifiable on pp6, 12, 14, 15: General local items 60,929 (penalties and interest on taxes 17,460, tuition 10,441, Public Power District 7,914, license fees 8,056, police court fines 9,782, community services 3,775, contributions 1,544, misc 1,651, other), School Nutrition 15,410 (non-reimbursable programs 7,341 + other 8,069), Special Building 4,043 (PPD tax 1,358 + penalties 2,685), QCPU penalties 454. The review note only says 'mixed local sources' and doesn't name the mix.
